import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import resource

# near 4 MiB aggregate input
lines = []
for i in range(8):
    services = ["s" * 60 + "%02d" % j for j in range(24)]
    rules = [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": [services[0]]}}]
    queries = [[services[j % 24]] * 4096 for j in range(4)]
    lines.append(json.dumps({"services": services, "rules": rules, "queries": queries}))
payload = ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode()
print("input bytes:", len(payload))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                   capture_output=True, timeout=300)
el = time.time() - t0
print("rc=%d time=%.2fs stdout=%d bytes" % (p.returncode, el, len(p.stdout)))
print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:500])

# 1 MiB single line
one = json.dumps({"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096] * 4})
print("single line bytes:", len(one))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=(one + "\n").encode(),
                   capture_output=True, timeout=300)
